0	# Ping-pong API
1	
2	Small HTTP API with TypeScript, Go, and Rust implementations.
3	
4	## TypeScript
5	
6	Run locally:
7	
8	```bash
9	npm install
10	npm run dev
11	```
12	
13	The server listens on port `3000` by default. Set `PORT` or `HOST` to change
14	the binding.
15	
16	## Endpoint
17	
18	```bash
19	curl http://localhost:3000/ping
20	# {"message":"pong"}
21	```
22	
23	Only `GET /ping` is supported. Unknown routes return `404`, and other methods
24	on `/ping` return `405`.
25	
26	## Verify
27	
28	```bash
29	npm test
30	```
31	
32	## Go and Rust
33	
34	The equivalent implementations live in [`go/`](go/) and [`rust/`](rust/).
35	Each directory is self-contained and includes its own run and test instructions.
36	
37	All three implementations expose the same contract:
38	
39	- `GET /ping` returns `200` with `{"message":"pong"}`.
40	- Other methods on `/ping` return `405` with `Allow: GET`.
41	- Unknown routes return `404` with `{"error":"Not Found"}`.
